title: Enable Upload API
desc: Let other programs on this computer queue G-code uploads through this Controller's connection (HTTP, upload only). Uploads wait until the machine is Idle.

title: Upload API port
desc: TCP port the Upload API listens on.

title: Allow other computers
desc: Listen on all network interfaces instead of only this computer. Requires a token.

title: Upload API token
desc: When set, clients must send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Required for other computers.

title: Allowed web origins
desc: Web pages (origins, separated by spaces) allowed to call the API from a browser, e.g. https://app.example.com. Leave empty to allow only non-browser clients.
